decisions.reason: The firm has invested in a multi-model LED track spotlight line that sits at the core of its modular lighting offer and presents it publicly on its own page, and with only one year on the market any weak results can still be put down to start-up effects, so dropping it would write off sunk investment and expose the launch decision.

The LED ceiling luminaire line is a visible, multi-model extension of the established range, backed by planning files and dealer displays, and it is too early to attribute disappointing results to anything but temporary causes, so management would persist with it.
